verdict: E-Q41 VERDICT (the cross-corpus transfer — the E-Q27 quantization laws re-run at 60 records on the eq36N substrate's OWN sealed vectors, ZERO typesafe calls, 180 upserts + 240 arm-filtered live queries, the recipe rule-identical with n=60 percentile indices): C39 DIES on H1 — THE QUANTIZATION LADDER DOES NOT TRANSFER, and the ternary zero's worth joins the family algebra as the SECOND SMALL-CORPUS ARTIFACT of the program. H1 DIES: binary 0.617 > ternary 0.567 (the n=20 ladder was 0.40 < 0.60 < 0.70 — the first rung INVERTS at 3x scale) while quad 0.733 stays on top. H2 DIES (the zero's margin: -0.05 vs the registered >= 0.10; at n=20 it was +0.20). H3 LIVES DECISIVELY: THE 4-LEVEL CODE IS NOW LOSSLESS IN COUNT — quad 0.733 == the same-session dense re-read 0.7333 (at n=20 the 4-level sat 0.10 below dense; at 60 records the 16-bit code loses NOTHING in count, though the miss SETS reshuffle — only 2/16 shared with dense's). THE MECHANISM (the autopsy row): the coarse codes are TIE-DEGENERATE at this scale — binary has a top-1 score tie on 32/60 records (adversarial bracket [0.467, 0.733]), ternary on 15/60 ([0.533, 0.633]), quad on 0/60 (bracket degenerate at [0.733, 0.733] — convention-free); the live readings sit inside their brackets, the local-vs-live disagreements (P4 DIES) live exactly on the tie-degenerate arms and vanish on the tie-free arm — the E-Q30 local==live law refines to: LOCAL==LIVE IFF TIE-FREE AT THE OPERATING SCALE. Two candidate mechanisms for the inversion are tested and FALSIFIED in the autopsy: mean separation (ternary 0.312 BEATS binary 0.226 while losing the strict accuracy — mean separation is not the top-1 operator) and zeroed-axes load (1.9 vs 2.0 vs 1.7 — no material difference). The receipts that scale: the dense arm re-read replicated the sealed E-Q36 reading EXACTLY (0.7333, delta 0.0000, F4 PASS — the live index is a stable executor across sessions); the ternary zero-level mass 0.2125 sits in the predicted [0.15, 0.35] (n=20: 0.2375 — a distribution property, scale-stable); every arm >= 2.4x the 14/59 majority floor. PREDICTIONS: P1 HIT, P2 HIT (the perfect replication), P3 HIT, P4 MISS (the tie mechanism — the prediction assumed tie-free codes at 60 records). The operative summary for the code designer: at 16 bits/record the 4-LEVEL code is the scale-robust choice (tie-free, count-lossless, miss-set-fluid); the ternary zero is a 20-record luxury; ANY strict-accuracy claim on a coarse code must report its tie bracket or a tie-breaking convention.

note: THE TIE-DEGENERACY MECHANISM: binary top-1 ties 32/60 (bracket [0.467, 0.733]); ternary 15/60 ([0.533, 0.633]); quad 0/60 (degenerate [0.733, 0.733]); local!=live exactly on the tie-degenerate arms — local==live IFF tie-free; mean-separation and zeroed-axes accounts both FALSIFIED; the 4-level code is tie-free, count-lossless (2/16 shared misses with dense), and the dense arm replicated exactly across sessions (delta 0.0000)
